job.title: Technical Product Owner – SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris)

tailoring.headline: Technical Product Owner – SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) | Business Analysis, OCC APIs & Integrations
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) specialist with 5+ years of experience bridging business requirements and technical delivery for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven track record in requirements analysis, user stories, process mapping, and solution design across enterprise e-commerce platforms. Experienced in leading API migrations, PIM/ERP integrations, and supporting UAT alongside cross-functional agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User leveraging AI tools to accelerate analysis, functional specifications, and platform delivery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Technical Product Owner – SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris)
cover_en.hook: 3M's global footprint and diverse product portfolios require e-commerce platforms where complex commercial needs translate seamlessly into robust digital execution. With over five years of enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I specialize in connecting business objectives with technical implementation.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Product Ownership
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation, worked in a techno-functional capacity analyzing business requirements, authoring user stories and functional specifications, and shaping scalable SAP Commerce Cloud 2211 solutions.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, DataHub, and Hotfolders, and resolved integration bottlenecks across SAP ERP, MDM, and commercial channels with global technical teams.

bullets.label: Headless API Strategy & Migration
bullets.text: Engineered API migrations and developed OCC REST Web Services for headless storefronts and external consumers, ensuring data consistency and platform stability.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Agile Alignment
bullets.text: Collaborated with product owners and business teams at Shell to map workflows, conduct user acceptance testing (UAT), and execute CI/CD release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2).

cover_en.logistics: Living in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit (no sponsorship required), I am currently serving my notice period until 15 December 2026 and available to start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my techno-functional background can support 3M's digital commerce goals.

tailoring.why_company: 3M’s relentless focus on scientific innovation and global market leadership demands digital commerce solutions that are scalable, reliable, and user-centric. I am eager to contribute my techno-functional SAP Commerce Cloud experience to help 3M harmonize complex product catalogs, align business stakeholders with technical development teams, and optimize enterprise digital channels.
tailoring.motivation_short: Eager to bring 5+ years of techno-functional SAP Commerce Cloud experience, agile requirements analysis, and enterprise PIM/ERP integration expertise to 3M as Technical Product Owner.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell—translating complex business requirements into user stories, OCC APIs, and ERP integrations—I would love to connect regarding the Technical Product Owner role at 3M.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Technical Product Owner – SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Technical Product Owner – SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) role at 3M.

With over five years of techno-functional experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring proven skill in translating business requirements into detailed user stories, solution designs, and robust ERP/PIM integrations. Based in Karlsruhe with full work authorization, I look forward to speaking with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
